metadata.description: Sherpa — composable frame/shape/implement/review/triage/restory layers; the user composes the workflow

plugins.name: sherpa
plugins.description: Develop like a sherpa: composable /frame, /shape, /implement skills — one per layer (macro, shape, build) — plus /review, /triage, and /restory skills for reviewing, triaging, and reconstructing story context, with bundled codebase-explorer/review/build subagents. The user composes the workflow; nothing persists unless you call /persist. Extend via project packs.
